sources.title: Hongchi Xia
sources.snippet: My research lies in 3D computer vision, building essential foundations for spatial intelligence. Previously, I conducted a series of works related to 3D reconstruction and photorealistic re-simulation with grounded physics. Recently, I've gone into 3D generation, aiming at addressing the urgent need for rich and diverse 3D data.
